Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: After the Planner explicitly requested corroboration beyond Wikipedia and to open authoritative sources (e.g., ThePeerage, FamilySearch, WeRelate) to extract and cite the death date, WebSurfer repeated a generic DuckDuckGo search and did not open or cite any of those sources. This failure to follow instructions and to progress beyond the search results page led to a loop of redundant queries without providing the requested verified citations, risking an incomplete/unsupported solution.
